title: Chapter 313: Terrifying Spatial Overlap
content:
Chapter 313: Terrifying Spatial Overlap

The Zerg army must have enough Zerg scorpions to fight against the weird.

The current system resources are sufficient. Wu Qing consumed a lot of system resources to hatch one hundred seven-star Zerg scorpions and one thousand six-star Zerg scorpions.

Wu Qing felt a little painful for such resource consumption, but with these Zerg scorpions, the combat power of the Zerg army has been improved to an extremely terrifying level.

It's worth it.

Wu Qing needs to continue to feel pain.

He consumed a lot of resources and continued to hatch ten seven-star Zerg queens, ten seven-star Zerg mammoths, one hundred six-star Zerg queens and one thousand six-star Zerg mammoths.

The Zerg Queen cannot use the parasitic control ability to fight against the weird. She can only use spawning to deal with the powerful weird and use trapping to assist in combat.

The number can be reduced temporarily to save resources and increase the number of other arms.

The Zerg Mammoth is the overlord of the Zerg's ground battlefield in the future. Each Zerg Mammoth brings a group of Zerg puppies and can be invincible on the ground.

So the number of six-star Zerg Mammoths is also one thousand. Ten seven-star Mammoths will be in charge. When needed, the Zerg's ground attack capability will be stronger.

Next is the main combat force with a large number of troops. This is where the most resources are consumed. With more troops, the total resource consumption is an astonishing number.

But if the system resources are kept, they will not get interest. Wu Qing now has so many resources in his hands, and he is ready to consume them all at once.

In order to get a greater harvest, it is acceptable to suffer a little now.

300,000 five-star Zerg air guards, 300,000 five-star Zerg devourers, 500,000 five-star Zerg flying dragons and 100,000 five-star Zerg hosts.

This is the main combat configuration Wu Qing gave to the Zerg's full-time extermination troops.

The Zerg Sky Guards and Zerg Devourers undertake the main attack mission, the Zerg Dragons assist in the attack, and the 100,000 five-star Zerg Hosts are responsible for mental attacks.

Wu Qing had never thought of deploying so many high-star Zerg Hosts in a unit before. The main tasks of the Zerg Hosts are reconnaissance and transportation.

Since the Queen of Zerg has developed a method of applying the mental power suitable for the Zerg, the Zerg Host, the Zerg soldier with the strongest mental power, has an important role in addition to reconnaissance and transportation.

These 100,000 five-star Zerg Hosts are distributed in various positions on the battlefield in stealth, forming a formation to carry out mental attacks, which is the best way to clear a large number of weaker weirds.

For those weirds that cannot withstand the mental attacks of the five-star Zerg Hosts, the Zerg Hosts are battlefield screen clearers.

Moreover, the mental attacks of the Zerg Hosts can independently control the attack intensity and will not cause waste.

With these 100,000 five-star Zerg Hosts, when facing a large number of weak weirds, there is no need for the main attack arms of the Zerg Extermination Force to waste combat power to attack.

Wu Qing thought about it and formed a team of one seven-star and one hundred six-star soldiers for all other combat arms. The ground troops were carried by transport Zerg hosts and followed the Zerg extermination troops to test the combat effectiveness of each arm at high star strength.

Except for the Zerg poisonous ray scorpion that Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg developed completely by themselves, other Zerg arms are designed for complex space environments. The stronger they are, the more they can show their terrible combat power.

Wu Qing needs to know the combat performance of all Zerg arms at high star levels, so that when encountering different battlefield environments, he can adjust the configuration of arms and forces in time, so that different Zerg arms can exert their strongest combat power.

In the third Zerg sub-base in the desert territory, the newly formed Zerg extermination troops are ready.

Although there are only more than one million troops, this force is the strongest combat power of the Zerg that consumes almost all system resources.

All the troops of the Zerg extermination force are five-star and above. Under the command of the Queen of Zerg, this force is fearless.

With such a powerful force here, Wu Qing wanted to find a suitable enemy to fight, but he couldn't find an opponent for a while.

Except for the main city of the alien race in the public battlefield of the southern theater, which did not want to launch a full-scale attack for the time being, there were no enemies worthy of the Zerg extermination force in other battlefields.

Outside the ancient desert territory, no large gathering places of the evil god camp races have been found. There are only some scattered small desert race gathering places, which are not worth a big fight.

Having no opponents is also a very helpless thing, especially for the Zerg.

Until the night fell, the Zerg extermination force, which had been on standby in the strange battlefield last night, finally took action.

The Zerg scorpion carried by the transport Zerg host released black bees to protect the Zerg extermination force. A large number of micro-insects multiplied rapidly, and a large area of black fog was formed in an instant, covering the entire Zerg extermination force.

The enemies outside cannot see the Zerg army in the black fog and cannot lock on to attack. They attack the black fog indiscriminately. The strange micro-insects that make up the black fog will form a powerful defense.

Enemies who rashly enter the black fog will be attacked and suppressed by the micro-insects. Weak enemies will be killed, and strong enemies will also be suppressed.

After the loss of the micro-insects that make up the black fog, the Zerg scorpions can continue to release black bees for replenishment and reinforcement. The more micro-insects there are, the stronger the various abilities of the black fog will be.

More than one million Zerg extermination troops, under the protection of the black fog, rushed out of the lord's protection range and exposed themselves to the world full of weirdness.

The weirdness has a stress response. If a strong army does not kill a large number of low-level weirdness in the initial attack, it may not attract powerful weirdness, but as long as a large number of weirdness are eliminated, more powerful weirdness will definitely appear.

If the fight continues, the weirdness will become stronger and stronger. If it were not for the level of dawn, I don't know what will happen later.

Now the Zerg extermination troops actively invite the weirdness to fight. Wu Qing still feels that one night is too tight, so he must seize the time to attract more and more powerful weirdness.

More than one million Zerg extermination troops rushed into the night sky above the desert. The five-star Zerg host controlled the intensity of the attack and cleaned up all the weirdness wherever it passed.

The Zerg extermination troops are extremely mobile, and the speed of the five-star Zerg host to sort out ordinary weirdness is also very fast. They rushed all the way, and countless weirdness active outside became system resources.

More than one million Zerg extermination troops, covered with a layer of black fog, moved quickly across the vast desert like a huge dark cloud.

Under this dark cloud, there were countless tiny lights flickering, which were all traces of the disappearing weird light.

In this way, the Zerg extermination troops circled around and eliminated countless weirds. The originally dark world suddenly changed, and the whole world was like a mirror, suddenly cracking into many cracks!

"The spatial rules of this world are too fragile!"

"It's all become a sieve!"

Wu Qing couldn't help but sigh when he saw this scene.

The space where the Zerg army is located seems to overlap with a terrible space under the influence of an unknown force.

Those huge cracks are where the two spaces connect, which is a more terrible spatial overlap connection than the black block connection last night.

Various strange weirds, including the octopus weird last night, poured out from the cracks.

Because of the provocation of the Zerg extermination troops, tonight is no longer a small fight like yesterday, but a large space is connected to the unknown world. Countless weirdness rushes out from various space cracks like a fierce flood.

This kind of world-destroying scene would have scared anyone else, but this is exactly what Wu Qing wants to see.

"Bang Bang Bang...!"

The 300,000 five-star Zerg air guards with the longest range are stacked on a huge air position, covered with black mist composed of micro-bugs, and attack the space crack areas at different locations.

The magical micro-bugs released by the Zerg scorpion have no effect on the Zerg attack.

"Boom boom...!"

There are violent explosions everywhere.

The attack of five-star strength will hurt the weirdness in any form.

A large number of weirdnesses wail and disappear under the attack of the five-star Zerg air guards.

However, there are too many weirds rushing through a large number of giant space cracks, and there are many powerful weirds among them. Only 300,000 Zerg air guards are not enough to stop their attack.

Various weirds, braving the attacks of the Zerg air guards, charge at the Zerg army in various strange ways.

A large number of weak but very strange weirds constantly appear beside the Zerg troops in the black fog. This kind of weird has magical abilities, almost ignoring the spatial rules of this world, making it difficult to guard against.

The black bee of the Zerg scorpion is like a field composed of micro-bugs. Enemies that appear in the field will be attacked. Coupled with the mental attack of the five-star Zerg host, these most annoying weirds have limited impact on the Zerg extermination troops.

As long as they appear, they will die immediately.

Three hundred thousand five-star Zerg Devourers launched an attack. Their attack and killing effect is better than that of the five-star Zerg air guards. Not only can they directly kill a large number of weirds, but they can also infect any form of weirds through special spores.

The infected monsters had their abilities greatly reduced. As long as they were attacked, they would suffer huge damage.

At the beginning of the war, the two ultimate Zerg troops attacked at the same time, which basically stabilized the situation. The attack of the monsters was a gift to the Zerg monster-killing troops.

The demise of a large number of monsters attracted the attention of the powerful monsters.

"Ga ga ga...!"

The sound of the monster came and was intercepted by the queen. Wu Qing heard it through the Zerg host, but he could no longer feel the killing effect.
